methodology.imageEditing: Crop only, lossless PNG output; no synthesis, recolouring, upscaling or seam cloning.
methodology.colourMetrics: Mean encoded sRGB plus CIE76 difference of those mean colours under assumed D65. Measures digital image difference, not physical colour accuracy.
methodology.physicalScale: All repeat sizes are explicit low-confidence visualisation estimates, never manufacturer dimensions.
methodology.seamMetrics: Mean absolute RGB edge difference in 0–255 units. Useful for repeat diagnostics; does not prove texture periodicity.
